foto.unter: The first meeting of all three. Ever.

szenen.text: It happened. Trump, Putin and Xi at one table in Shenzhen. The first meeting of all three. Ever. One hour.
Trump about Putin, in front of the cameras: He's my friend.
Trump says the US, China and Russia are uniquely positioned to talk about cutting nuclear weapons. No deal announced. Yet.
Not in the room: Ukraine and Europe. Zelensky had warned of a new Yalta, big powers dividing up the world.
And Bitcoin? Over the last forty-eight hours: {chg}.
Our view: three men, one table. A new world order is being drawn, and markets will have to price it.
